step_coding.StepTitle: BATTERY switch ON. Left/Right GEN switches in NORM/ON.
Fire test A completed with correct aural/visual indications. Fire test B completed after ~10s pause.
APU switch ON. APU READY light illuminated.
ENG CRANK switch set to RIGHT; right engine spool-up observed.
Right throttle at IDLE. Throttle moved when RPM >=25%.
BLEED AIR knob rotated full clockwise back to NORM.
Light test executed with all annunciators verified.
Left DDI shows FCS page; right DDI shows BIT page. MPCD and HUD powered.
COMM1 preset 1 frequency programmed to 134.000 MHz.
ENG CRANK switch set to LEFT; left engine spool-up observed.
Left throttle moved from OFF to IDLE when RPM >=25%.
INS knob set to GND (airfield) or CV (carrier).
Radar knob in OPR and radar power online.
OBOGS control and FLOW switches confirmed ON.
FCS RESET manually pressed. FCS page brought up and reviewed for faults.
Flap switch confirmed in AUTO.
TAKEOFF TRIM button pressed and trim set.
Right DDI advanced from BIT root page to the FCS-MC BIT page.
FCS BIT final GO result reviewed on the FCS-MC page.
Refueling probe fully extended.
Refueling probe fully retracted.
Launch bar extended.
Launch bar retracted.
Arresting hook lowered.
Arresting hook raised.
Pitot heat switch ON.
Flap switch set to AUTO.
Parking brake released and aircraft ready to roll.
BINGO fuel value set to mission requirement.
Standby barometric altimeter matches local elevation/QNH.
Radar altimeter bug set to scenario-appropriate value.
Standby attitude indicator uncaged and free-moving.
Attitude source selector set to AUTO.
